name: Simple-TensoRF Augmentation
definition: An augmented version of TensoRF designed to prevent overfitting and distortions (floaters, incorrect object placement) when trained with sparse input views by reducing model capacity and constraining the scene geometry.
summary: Simple-TensoRF Augmentation mitigates overfitting in sparse-view TensoRF by training a lower-capacity model to generate reliable depth priors that supervise the main model.
